messages.text:
Konsensüse Uygun Kalın: Nexa Tam Düğüm 2.2.0.0 Sürümüne Güncelleyin

Nexa, protokol geliştirmeleriyle ilerliyor ve herkesin düğüm istemcilerini en son sürüme güncellemesini tavsiye ediyoruz.

Bu sürüm, kayan kontrol noktalarını içerir. Bir blok zincirde 200 derinliğe ulaştığında, düğüm onu ​​​​yerleşik olarak işaretler. Bu derinlikten itibaren işlem kesinleşir ve bu noktadan sonraki herhangi bir yeniden düzenleme reddedilir.

Borsalar ve hizmetler için bunun anlamı somuttur: 200 onaydan sonra bir işlem geri alınamaz.

Bu aynı zamanda yaklaşan hard-fork ve Tailstorm protokolünün etkinleştirilmesinden önceki son sürümdür. Konsensüse uygun kalmak ve istemcilerinizi güncellemek önemlidir. 👇

https://nexa.org/node
messages.translation:
Stay with Consensus: Update to Nexa Full Node version 2.2.0.0

Nexa is moving forward with protocol improvements, and we recommend that everyone update their node clients to the latest version.

This release includes rolling checkpoints. Once a block reaches a depth of 200 in the chain, the node marks it as settled. From that depth on, the transaction is final, and any reorganization past that point is rejected.

For exchanges and services the implication is concrete: after 200 confirmations, a transaction cannot be reversed.

This is also the last release before the upcoming hard fork and the activation of the Tailstorm protocol. It is important to stay with consensus and update your clients. 👇

https://nexa.org/node

messages.text:
Donanım Hızlandırma: Devre Yoluyla Ölçeklendirme

Bu serinin ikinci makalesinde, Nexa'nın doğrulama motoru; altı bileşen, bir bant ve bir okuma kafası kullanılarak oluşturulmuş ve herhangi bir yazılım çalıştırılmaksızın Alice'ten Bob'a yapılan bir ödemeyi gerçekleştirmesi sağlanmıştı.

Bant yalnızca ileri yönde hareket ettiği için, motor daha iyi bir Bitcoin'in karşılaması gereken dört koşuldan ilkini yerine getirmiş oldu: yani işlem hattı (pipeline) mimarisine uygunluk.

Bu makale ise geriye kalan koşulları ele alıyor. Nexa Baş Bilim İnsanı Dr. Peter Rizun'un (@PeterRizun) Sidney'de gösterdiği üzere, Satoshi'nin Bitcoin'ini iyileştirip yalnızca üç basit değişiklikle tüm bu koşulları sağlamasını mümkün kılabiliriz; üstelik bu süreçte motor, genişletilebilirlik ve sıkıştırılabilirlik gibi iki özelliği de neredeyse hiçbir ek maliyet olmaksızın kazanıyor.

https://forum.nexa.org/t/scaling-by-circuit/1749
messages.translation:
Hardware Acceleration: Scaling by Circuit

In the second article of this series, Nexa's validation engine was built using six components, a tape and a read head, and was made to execute a payment from Alice to Bob without running any software.

Since the tape only moves forward, the engine satisfied the first of the four conditions a better Bitcoin must meet: namely, compatibility with a pipeline architecture.

This article addresses the remaining conditions. As Nexa Chief Scientist Dr. Peter Rizun (@PeterRizun) demonstrated in Sydney, we can improve Satoshi's Bitcoin and make it satisfy all these conditions with just three simple changes; and in the process the engine also gains two features, extensibility and compressibility, at almost no additional cost.

https://forum.nexa.org/t/scaling-by-circuit/1749
messages.note: Official project announcement translated into Turkish for the local group.

summary.headline: Turkish Nexa community awaits the Tailstorm hard fork, cheers a price uptick, and debates macro and Trump
summary.summary: Over roughly a week, the Turkish Nexa group centred on the upcoming Tailstorm protocol upgrade and the hard fork it requires. Moderator Onur_Chinaski confirmed the hard fork is coming but said no date can be given, while X relayed that Andrew Stone considers Blitz and the Tokadex DEX essentially finished pending a hard-fork feature; Blacktea posted the official call to update nodes to Full-Node 2.2.0.0 (rolling checkpoints, last release before the fork). Price talk was frequent and repeatedly redirected by the Rose bot to the unofficial trade channel: a stubborn 14B sell wall, hopes of breaking '130', and a Monday pump that Green Zenci and Hakan greeted enthusiastically. Several members (X in particular) pushed the group to be more active on X/Twitter, complaining that only 30 of 631 members are online. The window closes with a macro/politics debate between Onur_Chinaski and X about US rate hikes, Houthi attacks on Saudi refineries pushing Brent to $109, and whether Trump staying or going would help or delay a bull run. Minor housekeeping included CAS bans, scam accounts being removed, and help joining the trade channel.

topics.title: Tailstorm and the hard fork
topics.summary: Hüseyin, Ariel Ortega and T. YAMAÇ asked about Tailstorm's timing and scope; Onur_Chinaski said testing is going well but refused to name a date and confirmed a mining-algorithm hard fork. X relayed Andrew Stone's note that Blitz and Tokadex are done but waiting on a hard-fork feature, and Green Zenci shared an explainer brochure.

topics.title: Price action, sell wall and market outlook
topics.summary: X predicted the '130' level would break and that the 14B sell order would vanish once Tailstorm lands; Uğur and Hydraa noted the wall has sat untouched for a week. Ariel Ortega and Hakan drew bullish parallels to previous bull cycles, while the Rose bot kept redirecting price talk to the unofficial trade channel.

topics.title: Macro, oil war and Trump debate
topics.summary: Onur_Chinaski blamed a US rate hike for capping upside; X countered that Houthi strikes on Saudi refineries and Brent at $109 are the real drag, then argued Trump must stay and hand out $5,000 cheques to fuel a bull run, which Onur_Chinaski called implausible.

topics.title: Node 2.2.0.0 update and wallets
topics.summary: Blacktea posted the official notice to update to Nexa Full-Node 2.2.0.0 with rolling checkpoints, the last release before the fork; Devrim Yılmaz reposted it and asked whether Otoplo wallet holders must act, and Onur_Chinaski reassured him no action is needed.

topics.title: Push for X/Twitter activity
topics.summary: X urged members to amplify Nexa on X, pointing out only 30 of 631 members are online; Green Zenci and Umut shared posts and Umut thanked people for likes, while Green Zenci argued the community must understand and explain the product to grow organically.

topics.title: Moderation, scammers and newcomers
topics.summary: Combot logged two CAS bans and Onur_Chinaski removed scam accounts (Hydraa joked about crypto scammers), helped Mehmet Aslan join the trade channel via Rose, and answered newcomer İrfan's 'is Nexa worth buying?' by pointing to the Turkish-translated pinned updates.

topics.title: Tech content, NFTs and dev pride
topics.summary: Blacktea shared Peter Rizun's 'Scaling by Circuit' article on hardware-accelerated validation; Green Zenci boasted that Nexa's lead developer said in 2022 what Ethereum's architect is saying now, and X praised Gidra's NFTs after Andrew Stone received one.

summary.mood_description: The dominant tone is optimistic anticipation: members believe Tailstorm, the DEX and the hard fork will re-rate the coin, and a Monday price move produced open celebration. Underneath runs impatience — calls not to drag the Tailstorm announcement out any longer, frustration that only a fraction of the 631 members are active on X, and grumbling about a 14B sell wall. Late in the window the mood turns more sober and argumentative as macro risks (rate hikes, Middle East war, oil at $109) and a Trump disagreement take over, though even that stays friendly.

highlights.why: The concrete operational news: official call to update to Full-Node 2.2.0.0, the last release before the hard fork and Tailstorm activation.
Moderator Onur_Chinaski's direct answer on Tailstorm timing — work going well, but explicitly no date.
Relays Andrew Stone's statement that Tokadex is basically finished and only waiting on a hard-fork feature.
Captures the community's self-criticism about low engagement: 631 members, 30 online.
The most heated stretch: X argues Trump must stay and hand out $5,000 to ignite a legendary bull run, which the moderator flatly doubts.
